<div class="hero-title" style="font-size: 2.2rem; margin-bottom: 0.5rem; font-weight: 700;">CINAS Multi-Sector Data Lake</div>
<div class="hero-subtitle" style="font-size: 1.15rem; margin-bottom: 1.5rem; color: #495057;">Unified Data Infrastructure for Artificial Intelligence, Epidemiology, and Public Policy</div>

The **CINAS Data Lake** consolidates an integrated public data infrastructure at the national level in Brazil, articulating over **220 GB of optimized columnar data** and hundreds of millions of curated records. Designed to overcome the historical fragmentation of health and social determinants data, the ecosystem supports multidisciplinary research in Artificial Intelligence, spatial epidemiology, nuclear medicine, health technology assessment, biomedical innovation, and predictive modeling for the public healthcare system (SUS).

The platform adopts the **Medallion Architecture** (Bronze, Silver, and Gold), rigorous semantic harmonization via **YAML contracts**, centralized governance powered by an **ACID DuckDB** database, and high-performance columnar storage in **Apache Parquet (ZSTD)**.
:::

## Strategic Axes & Integrated Providers {.mb-4}

The platform transcends isolated hospital analytics by articulating data across **sixteen national strategic providers and domains**:

::: {.grid .mb-5}

::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-6 .g-col-lg-4}
::: {.card .h-100 .shadow-sm .border-0 .p-3}
### {{< fa hospital >}} DATASUS
**Brazilian Ministry of Health (SUS)**

* **Hospital Inpatients (SIHSUS):** Care production, morbimortality, and hospital outcomes across Brazil.
* **Outpatient Care (SIASUS):** Specialized procedures, diagnostic exams, and psychosocial care.
* **Epidemiological Surveillance (SINAN):** Compulsory reporting of diseases and arboviruses.
* **Healthcare Facilities (CNES):** National registry of hospitals, clinics, beds, and health teams.
* **Vital Statistics:** Historical series of mortality (SIM) and live births (SINASC).
:::
:::

::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-6 .g-col-lg-4}
::: {.card .h-100 .shadow-sm .border-0 .p-3}
### {{< fa ribbon >}} Integrated Oncology
**FOSP (RHC-SP) & DATASUS (POBR)**

* **Oncology Panel (POBR):** Historical series (2013–2026) of time to cancer diagnosis and treatment (60/30-Day Laws).
* **Clinical Microdata (FOSP RHC):** Complete 2000–2026 series with 1.38 million cases, tumor staging (TNM), and histology (ICD-O-3).
* **Therapeutic Modalities:** First oncological treatment modalities (surgery, radiotherapy, chemotherapy).
* **Topography & Morphology:** ICD-O-3 histopathological classification linkable to ICD-10 and mortality registries (SIM).
:::
:::

::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-6 .g-col-lg-4}
::: {.card .h-100 .shadow-sm .border-0 .p-3}
### {{< fa cloud-sun >}} INMET
**National Institute of Meteorology**

* **Continuous Historical Records:** 84 million continuous, audited hourly weather measurements since 2008.
* **National Station Network:** Continuous monitoring across 672 telemetric stations in all 27 Brazilian states.
* **Environmental Variables:** Temperature, relative humidity, precipitation, solar radiation, and wind.
* **Health Impact:** Distributed lag non-linear modeling (DLNM) for thermal extremes and vector-borne diseases.
:::
:::

::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-6 .g-col-lg-4}
::: {.card .h-100 .shadow-sm .border-0 .p-3}
### {{< fa fire-flame-curved >}} Environment & Air Quality
**INPE (BDQueimadas) & CETESB (QUALAR)**

* **Fire Active Spots (INPE):** Daily satellite observations with Fire Radiative Power (FRP) and biomes.
* **Meteorological Fire Risk:** Biomass burning dynamics crossed with municipal boundaries.
* **Air Quality (CETESB):** Hourly telemetric series of atmospheric pollutants ($PM_{2.5}, PM_{10}, O_3, NO_2, SO_2, CO$).
* **Planetary Health:** Impact modeling of air pollution on cardiorespiratory hospital admissions.
:::
:::

::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-6 .g-col-lg-4}
::: {.card .h-100 .shadow-sm .border-0 .p-3}
### {{< fa users >}} Surveys & Demographics
**IBGE & Ministry of Health (PNS and Vigitel)**

* **Vigitel Brazil (2006–2024):** Uninterrupted 18-edition time series of 833,217 telephone interviews across 26 state capitals and DF, tracking NCD risk and protective factors.
* **National Health Survey (PNS):** 2013 and 2019 household microdata (516k interviews on NCDs, SUS access, and anthropometry) plus laboratory exam biomarkers (8,952 samples).
* **2022 Demographic Census:** Population, households, and granular spatial mapping across 468,099 census tracts in 5,570 municipalities.
* **Historical Series & Projections:** Long-term projections (2000–2070) by single age and POPSVS estimates (2000–2025).
* **Denominators & Survey Weights:** Standardized denominator foundation for incidence, population prevalence, and complex sample calibration (Rake).
:::
:::

::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-6 .g-col-lg-4}
::: {.card .h-100 .shadow-sm .border-0 .p-3}
### {{< fa pills >}} CMED & ANVISA
**Pharmaceutical Regulation & Pharmacovigilance**

* **Regulated Prices (CMED):** Factory ceiling prices (PF) and maximum consumer prices (PMC).
* **Public Procurement (PMVG/CAP):** Government price adequacy coefficients and procurement rules.
* **Registered Drugs:** Catalog of 32,800+ pharmaceutical presentations with therapeutic classes and active ingredients.
* **Pharmacovigilance (VigiMed):** Adverse event reports standardized using MedDRA and WHODrug.
:::
:::

::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-6 .g-col-lg-4}
::: {.card .h-100 .shadow-sm .border-0 .p-3}
### {{< fa microchip >}} Medical Devices
**ANVISA (Health Products & Equipment)**

* **Technology Infrastructure:** Official registry of 116,000+ medical devices and health products.
* **High-Complexity Equipment:** Imaging equipment (PET-CT, SPECT, CT scanners, MRI).
* **Radiotherapy & Biomedical:** Linear accelerators, brachytherapy systems, and implantable devices.
* **Lifecycle & Risk:** Risk classification (Classes I to IV), technical standards, and validity dates.
:::
:::

::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-6 .g-col-lg-4}
::: {.card .h-100 .shadow-sm .border-0 .p-3}
### {{< fa flask-vial >}} Clinical Research
**ClinicalTrials.gov & ReBEC (Fiocruz/MS)**

* **Global and National Clinical Trials:** International protocols (NLM/NIH) and national trials via ReBEC (ensaiosclinicos.gov.br).
* **WHO ICTRP & Ethics Approval:** 9,777 validated trials in Brazil with Plataforma Brasil CAAE and CEP/Conep approvals.
* **Innovation Pipeline:** Phase monitoring (Phases 1 to 4), recruitment status, novel molecules, and radiopharmaceuticals.
* **Clinical Conditions & Interventions:** Targeted diseases (DeCS/ICD-10), sponsors, and research center mappings.
:::
:::

::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-6 .g-col-lg-4}
::: {.card .h-100 .shadow-sm .border-0 .p-3}
### {{< fa shield-halved >}} ANS (Private Healthcare)
**National Supplementary Health Agency**

* **Sector Overview:** Insights on health plans covering over 50 million Brazilian beneficiaries.
* **Active Health Plans (CADOP):** Directory of 1,106 operators by corporate modality and coverage segment.
* **Beneficiaries (SIB):** Nearly 90 million medical and dental coverage links by age bracket and sex.
* **Financial Accounting (DIOPS):** Quarterly balance sheets, operational revenues, and healthcare claims.
:::
:::

::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-6 .g-col-lg-4}
::: {.card .h-100 .shadow-sm .border-0 .p-3}
### {{< fa scale-unbalanced >}} CONITEC
**Technology Incorporation in SUS**

* **Health Technology Assessment (HTA):** Deliberations and recommendations issued since 2012.
* **Clinical Protocols (PCDT):** Incorporation history of innovative therapies and radiopharmaceuticals.
* **Pharmacoeconomics:** Mapping of applicants, clinical specialties, and evaluation turnaround times.
* **Regulatory Integration:** Analytical joins with ANVISA registrations and CMED price ceilings.
:::
:::

::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-6 .g-col-lg-4}
::: {.card .h-100 .shadow-sm .border-0 .p-3}
### {{< fa scale-balanced >}} IPEA & UNDP
**Social Vulnerability & Human Development**

* **Social Vulnerability Index (SVI/IVS):** Urban infrastructure, human capital, and income indicators.
* **Municipal Human Development Index (MHDI/IDHM):** Longevity, education, and municipal income.
* **Social Determinants:** Control of socioeconomic inequalities in clinical research and AI models.
* **National & Regional Coverage:** 103 socioeconomic variables for all 5,570 Brazilian municipalities.
:::
:::

::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-6 .g-col-lg-4}
::: {.card .h-100 .shadow-sm .border-0 .p-3}
### {{< fa file-invoice-dollar >}} Procurement & Budgets
**PNCP & SIOPS (Ministry of Health)**

* **Public Procurement (PNCP):** Contracts, tenders, and pricing agreements under Federal Law 14,133/2021.
* **Effective Unit Prices:** Transparency in public acquisition of hospital supplies and medications.
* **Public Health Budgets (SIOPS):** Execution of constitutional healthcare revenues and expenses (ASPS).
* **Fiscal Capacity:** Correlations between municipal per capita healthcare investments and health outcomes.
:::
:::

:::

## Platform Pillars and Scientific Governance {.mb-4}

::: {.grid .mb-5}

::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-4}
::: {.card .h-100 .border-0 .shadow-sm .p-3}
#### {{< fa layers-group >}} Medallion Architecture
Three-tier structured processing: **Bronze (Mirror)** with immutable raw files; **Silver (Data Lake)** in partitioned columnar Apache Parquet; and **Gold (Dimensions)** with 21 standardized lookup tables (*Star Schema*).
:::
:::

::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-4}
::: {.card .h-100 .border-0 .shadow-sm .p-3}
#### {{< fa network-wired >}} Semantic Interoperability
Cross-domain standardization rooted in universal codes and YAML metadata contracts: IBGE geocodes, ICD-10, CBO, CNES, SIGTAP, ANVISA registries, MedDRA, WHODrug, unified PNS and Vigitel dictionaries, and trial identifiers.
:::
:::

::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-4}
::: {.card .h-100 .border-0 .shadow-sm .p-3}
#### {{< fa check-double >}} Traceability and Reproducibility
ACID audit via DuckDB (`manifesto.duckdb`), formal 5-layer data lineage catalog (DAMA-DMBOK) under unified *data stewardship*, SHA-256 cryptographic hashes, and strict physical timestamp (`mtime`) preservation, ensuring 100% reproducible scientific experiments and AI models.
:::
:::

:::
